scholarships.title: Nankai University Chinese Government Scholarship - Silk Road Program

existing.description: The Silk Road Program is one of Nankai University's Chinese Government Scholarship streams for international students from ten named countries. For the 2026 round it offered five programmes: Business Economics, Business Administration and Finance at bachelor's level taught in Chinese, and International Business plus International Affairs and Public Policy at master's level. The award covers tuition, free on-campus accommodation, a living stipend of RMB 2,500 per month for bachelor's and RMB 3,000 for master's students, and comprehensive medical insurance. Applicants apply through Nankai University's online platform by 18 May 2026, are interviewed, and if nominated complete the CSC application under Program Type B with Nankai as agency number 10055.
eligibility: Non-Chinese citizen in good physical and mental health, with no criminal record, strong academic performance and a friendly attitude toward China
National of Vietnam, Malaysia, Thailand, Myanmar, Pakistan, Mongolia, Indonesia, Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan or Colombia
Bachelor's applicants: high school diploma and under age 25
Master's applicants: bachelor's degree and under age 35
Must not hold any other scholarships
Chinese-taught programmes: HSK Level 5 with a score of 210 or above

English-taught programmes: IELTS 6.0, TOEFL 80 or Duolingo 105; exemptions may be granted for applicants from English-speaking countries subject to Nankai's approval, and applicants whose previous degree was completed entirely in English may submit an official English-medium instruction letter instead
Bachelor's applicants must take the CSCA Test (China Scholastic Competency Assessment)
All documents must be in Chinese or English, with notarized Chinese or English translations for anything else
existing.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good physical and mental health with no criminal record, strong academic performance and a friendly attitude toward China, from one of ten named countries. Bachelor's applicants need a high school diploma and be under 25; master's applicants need a bachelor's degree and be under 35. Applicants must hold no other scholarship. Chinese-taught programmes require HSK Level 5 with 210 or above; English-taught programmes require IELTS 6.0, TOEFL 80 or Duolingo 105. Bachelor's applicants must take the CSCA test.
benefits: Living stipend of RMB 2,500 per month (bachelor)
Living stipend of RMB 3,000 per month (master)
coverage: Living stipend of RMB 2,500 per month for bachelor's students and RMB 3,000 per month for master's students
requirements: Submit the application through Nankai University's Online Service Platform for International Students at https://nankai.at0086.cn/StuApplication/Login.aspx
Monitor the application account for interview notifications sent by system email

After nomination and a pre-admission letter, log in to the CSC portal at https://studyinchina.csc.edu.cn, select Program Type B and designate Nankai University (Agency No. 10055) as the host institution
Upload colour PDF scans; mobile phone photos and photocopies are not accepted
documents: Copy of the passport information page, valid until at least 1 September 2027; applicants currently in Chinese mainland must also provide a copy of their valid visa or residence permit
High school or bachelor's degree certificate; graduating students must submit a pre-graduation certificate, with notarized Chinese or English translations for non-Chinese/English documents
Complete academic transcripts with notarized Chinese or English translations
Bachelor's applicants: scanned copy of the CSCA Test score report
Personal statement of at least 800 words for master's applicants, including study and research plan in China, financial background, reasons for applying, awards and personal strengths
HSK Level 5 with 210 or above for Chinese-taught programmes (graduates of independent Chinese secondary schools in Malaysia are exempt on submission of their graduation certificate)
IELTS 6.0, TOEFL 80 or Duolingo 105 for master's applicants, or an official English-medium instruction letter where the previous degree was fully taught in English
Recommendation letters: one for bachelor's applicants, two from associate or full professors for master's applicants, in Chinese or English
Foreigner Physical Examination Form completed in Chinese or English; reports dated after October 2025 are valid
existing.english_requirement: IELTS 6.0, TOEFL 80 or Duolingo 105 for English-taught master's programmes; HSK Level 5 with 210 or above for Chinese-taught programmes.
application_method: Apply through Nankai University's online service platform for international students
Nankai University reviews applications and conducts interviews
Successful applicants are nominated by Nankai University and issued pre-admission letters
Nominees complete the CSC online application under Program Type B with Nankai as host institution
Nankai forwards pre-admission documents to the CSC, which makes the final admission decision
Nankai announces final results and issues the Admission Notice and Visa Application Form
existing.selection_notes: Nankai University will review applications and conduct interviews, and interview notifications are sent through the system email, so applicants are advised to monitor their application account closely. The final list of programmes is subject to approval by the China Scholarship Council. Incomplete or non-compliant submissions will not be processed, and Nankai may request additional documents during review.
existing.best_fit: Bangladeshi students in business, economics, and international affairs
existing.duration: Not stated on the official page; the registration date for the 2026 round was early September 2026.
existing.application_period: The 2026 Silk Road round accepted applications until 18 May 2026, with registration for awardees in early September 2026. The round is annual; the 2027 call had not been published as of 2026-10-04.
existing.deadline_display: Application Deadline: From now until May 18, 2026.
existing.program_type: Chinese Government Scholarship Silk Road Program, nominated by Nankai University (CSC agency number 10055) under Program Type B

scholarships.title: UCAS Scholarship for International Students
scholarships.official_source: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (UCAS)

existing.description: The UCAS Scholarship for International Students is a University of Chinese Academy of Sciences award for non-Chinese-citizen students pursuing a Master's or doctoral degree, or attending courses, conducting research or making academic visits at UCAS colleges and CAS institutes. It has two tiers: a full scholarship covering tuition waiver, application fee waiver, monthly stipend, basic accommodation and medical insurance, and a partial scholarship covering only the tuition waiver, insurance and application fee. Awards run for no longer than 36 months, and the full tier publishes RMB 40,000/year (PhD) or RMB 30,000/year (Master's) tuition waived plus a monthly stipend of RMB 2,500 (PhD) or RMB 2,000 (Master's), with a combined total of at least RMB 3,500 or RMB 3,000 once the host assistantship is added.
eligibility: NOT hold Chinese citizenship, with a valid foreign passport
Friendly to China and abiding by the laws and decrees of China and UCAS rules
Be proficient in English or Chinese
Senior visiting students: born after 1 January 1981 (inclusive)
Regular visiting students: born after 1 January 1986 (inclusive)
Joint programme applicants: no age limitation
Meet the admission criteria for international students of UCAS
NOT take up other assignments during the period of the scholarship
existing.eligibility_summary: Applicants must not hold Chinese citizenship, must hold a valid foreign passport, must be proficient in English or Chinese, must meet UCAS admission criteria for international students, and must not hold another assignment during the scholarship period. Age limits apply by programme.
coverage: Tuition waiver: RMB 40,000/year for PhD and RMB 30,000/year for Master's students
Monthly stipend: RMB 2,500 (PhD) or RMB 2,000 (Master) from UCAS, with the total monthly amount no less than RMB 3,500 (PhD) or RMB 3,000 (Master) once the host assistantship is added
Basic accommodation for awardees from faculties and institutes located in Beijing
requirements: Apply through the UCAS Online Admission System for International Students and choose 'UCAS Scholarship for International Students'
You may not apply to this scholarship with two supervisors simultaneously
Students already pursuing a master's or doctoral degree in China are not eligible for the corresponding programme
documents: Materials listed in the Call for 2026 Master's/Doctoral Degree Programs for International Students
Materials listed in the Call for 2026 Visiting Students Programs for International Students (visiting applicants)
Two referees uploaded through the online system
existing.english_requirement: Proficiency in English or Chinese is required; the official call states 'Be proficient in English or Chinese' and publishes no specific test score.
application_method: Log in to the Online Admission System for International Students at UCAS (is.ucas.ac.cn)
Complete all required application procedures and upload the materials listed in the relevant programme call
Select 'UCAS Scholarship for International Students' in the application
File and submit the application in the system before the deadline
existing.selection_notes: The scholarship is majorly sponsored for Master's and doctoral candidates; the full scholarship is the main award tier and a partial tier also exists.
existing.best_fit: International Master's and PhD applicants to UCAS who need full tuition support plus a living stipend.
existing.notes: The scheme has two tiers. The full scholarship covers tuition waiver, application fee waiver, monthly stipend, basic accommodation and medical insurance. The partial scholarship covers only items a), d) and e) - that is, the tuition waiver, medical insurance and application fee - so it carries no stipend and no accommodation.
existing.application_period: Annual cycle tied to the Call for 2026 Master's/Doctoral Degree Programs for International Students; the 2026 call has closed and no 2027 call is published yet.
existing.deadline_display: For PhD and Master's programs: 31st January 2026 (Beijing Time). For Senior visiting and Regular visiting programs: no deadline.
existing.program_type: University-funded scholarship administered by UCAS International Students Office
